settings.window_fit.desc1: Off by default. When enabled, the window is sized to the current screen's work area and the UI is scaled down in smaller windows. Suitable for 1366 × 768 and similar small screens. It does not change monitor resolution, images or game graphics quality.
settings.window_fit.desc2: Manual zoom is still available; disabling reverts to the manual zoom level.
settings.motion.title: Reduce Motion
settings.motion.desc: Stops decorative animations and auto-rotation; shortens transitions. Also applies automatically when the system has Reduce Motion enabled.
settings.motion.system_off: The system has animations disabled: launch shows the full avatar and skins stay in a standing pose.
settings.motion.help.darwin: To enable animations, turn off "Reduce Motion" in System Settings → Accessibility → Display.
settings.motion.help.win32: To enable animations, turn on "Animation effects" in Windows Settings → Accessibility → Visual effects.
settings.motion.help.other: To enable animations, check your desktop's accessibility or animation settings.

settings.download.desc: New game versions, modpacks and shared resources (libraries, game assets, auto-downloaded Java) are stored here.
settings.download.after_change: Only affects new tasks. Existing games, saves and in-progress downloads keep their original location. You can choose a target folder per import. Archive download and extraction may temporarily use the system temp directory.
